description: This file defines an AdminPanel React component for managing security settings, including SSO configuration, allowed IPs, and user roles. It includes UI elements, state management, and interactions with backend APIs.

methods.name: checkSSOConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches SSO configuration from backend and updates ssoConfigured state based on presence of provider credentials.

methods.name: handleShowAllowedIPs
methods.description: Fetches allowed IPs from backend and displays modal for management.

methods.name: handleAddIP
methods.description: Adds a new allowed IP address via backend API and updates the list.

methods.name: handleDeleteIP
methods.description: Prepares to delete a specified IP address.

methods.name: confirmDeleteIP
methods.description: Confirms and executes deletion of a specified IP address.

methods.name: handleAddSSOOk
methods.description: Handles success of adding/editing SSO settings, refreshes configuration status.

methods.name: handleShowInstructions
methods.description: Displays instructions modal for SSO setup.

methods.name: handleInstructionsOk
methods.description: Handles confirmation of instructions modal, refreshes SSO config.

methods.name: handleInstructionsCancel
methods.description: Cancels instructions modal, refreshes SSO config.

methods.name: fetchProxyAdminInfo
methods.description: Fetches and consolidates admin and proxy users data on component load.

methods.name: handleMemberUpdate
methods.description: Updates a member's role and details in the backend.

methods.name: handleMemberCreate
methods.description: Creates a new member and sends invite link.

methods.name: handleAdminCreate
methods.description: Creates a new admin user and sends invite.
